asked.item: Caption text not showing on the Instagram Story
Is the caption field the wrong field?
How to get text to show on the Story
What to put in the caption field for a Story

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that caption text does not appear on published Instagram Stories and give the workaround of rendering text into the media.

steps.text: Instagram Stories do not support captions through Meta's publishing API.
Text entered in an API, MCP, n8n, or Make.com caption field does not appear on the published Story, so the caption field is not a place to show text on a Story.
To show text on a Story, add the text to the image or video before publishing.
In n8n, leave the Caption field empty for an Instagram Story.
